content: Intellect annuls Fate. So far as a man thinks, he is free.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Physical necessity and blind conditioning govern only the unconscious. The moment human consciousness awakens in thoughtful reflection, it claims moral freedom.
practicalInsight: When feeling trapped by circumstance, pause and apply rational analysis: there is always a free choice in your attitude and response.
reflectionPrompt: Where can you exercise your sovereign freedom of thought in a challenging situation today?
